data.review_body:
I've had decent luck with shein. However I wish they would allow you to take your wishlist and break it into categories (I know they have boards to copy the items to, but it doesn't remove that item from the main wishlist, so I'm still having to scroll through almost 2000 things to find anything I haven't been able to categorize yet) I wish it was more like Amazon where if you add something to a list it's only on that SPECIFIC list, not part of a two thousand item list. 

I've had hit and miss with the return/refund policies. I wanted to leave feedback and a suggestion for them but there's no way to do that. Item quality varies and be sure to pay close attention to which options you've selected because sometimes there's an item that says like 0.89 but then you go to the listing and the actual thing you want is like 8 bucks and the listing price was for some random crap like a clear hook or things like that.
data.review_headline: I've had decent luck with shein

data.review_body:
Parcel ID: H023FA1321733725
Order ID: GSO1YB14B004475
Order time: 2026-05-15 22:53:12

I wrote a truthful review about Shein on June 16th. An order I had placed had not been received. The delivery company, EVRI, left the parcel on my doorstep without notifying me that they had done so, or indeed, that they even had the package. 
Shein responded on the Trustpilot platform, then Viviana from the company contacted me by email on 18th June, asking that I withdraw my complaint which she wrote is causing a refund that they wanted to sanction, being blocked by PayPal. I contacted PayPal and money being held had been released to Shein the week prior. I was assured that I would receive a refund "immediately". Three weeks later, I am still waiting and Viviana is not responding to my emails. How disgraceful! Shein has definitely lost its shine. Their response and promise of a refund was just for show.
